label: Shape selected · Lamplight
note: Toolbar: lock, then 8 groups with hairline dividers. The pen slot shows the current pen and its colour dot; Shapes and Arrow are split buttons that remember the last choice. Tooltips read “Name · key”. Property bar floats 24 px above the selection; each control opens a small popover.

label: Pen active · bar docks under toolbar
note: Nothing selected and a tool active: the same bar docks under the toolbar and shows the tool’s settings. It never overlaps the toolbar.

label: Board header ⋯ menu
note: Board settings, Layers, Frames, Present, Export, Convert, History, Handwriting search, Zen.

label: Tool wheel · desktop
note: Opens at the pointer. Pens show their colour dot. Esc or click outside closes it.

label: Tool wheel · phone
note: Long-press with a finger. In pen mode a finger pans, so the wheel opens on a two-finger long-press instead.

label: Empty board
note: Draw (primary), Add a note card, Paste an image. Dropping files works here too.

label: View-only shared link · Paper
note: Toolbar hidden. Header offers Duplicate to my vault. Zoom and frames still work.

label: Offline
note: Header line turns amber: Saved on device. Everything except AI convert keeps working.

label: Large board · performance mode
note: Over ~3,000 elements shadows and hand-drawn roughness switch off; a chip says so and lets you undo it.

label: Arabic · RTL
note: Toolbar, panels and header mirror; the drawing, arrows and handwriting do not.

label: Pen popover · Lamplight
note: Saved pens (up to 8, synced) sit first: most people switch pens, not settings. Pencil and Calligraphy are tagged Later. Thickness 0.5–24 px with five preset dots.

label: Pen popover · Paper
note: Lumen ink flips per theme: the same pen draws dark ink on Paper.

label: Pen sheet · phone, pen mode on
note: Stylus draws, finger pans. Auto-detected on the first stylus touch; the chip under the header shows it and toggles it.

label: Eraser modes, ruler, scratch-out
note: Each eraser has three sizes. The ruler rotates with two fingers; Shift snaps to 15°.

label: Auto-shape · Undo snap chip
note: Rough circle → clean ellipse. The chip stays 3 s with a countdown ring, then fades. Snapping is one undo step.

label: Lasso selection · desktop
note: Convert to shapes runs on device. Text, Math and Mermaid use the vision model and always go through review.

label: Lasso · phone
note: The action bar sits above the dock and wraps to two rows.

label: Handwriting search badge
note: Recognised text is stored invisibly; the header shows Searchable so you know search will find your ink.

label: Convert to text
note: Editable result in the reading font. One neuron per convert, shown in the header so the daily limit is never a surprise.

label: Convert to math · Paper
note: LaTeX source with a rendered preview under it.

label: Convert to Mermaid
note: Live Mermaid code; Open as architecture diagram hands it to the studio (page 46).

label: Low confidence
note: Unsure words are highlighted on both sides; click one to see alternatives.

label: Phone · full screen
note: Ink on top, result below; buttons wrap.

label: Library · Lamplight
note: The Shapes split button remembers the last shape (here Rectangle) and opens this panel.

label: Connector popover
note: Path, heads per end (start | end), line style, label. Bound arrows follow their shapes.

label: Stamps and icon insert
note: Stamps are Lumen glyphs, never emoji. Icon insert offers the whole glyph set, recolourable.

label: Lumen ink · Lamplight
note: Opened from the property bar’s stroke swatch.

label: Palette switcher open
note: Each palette shows a strip of its first colours.

label: Colour-blind safe + contrast warning · Paper
note: Okabe-Ito with names in tooltips. Text on this fill fails AA, so a warning suggests a darker shade.

label: Palettes + custom editor
note: Create, name, add from eyedropper or hex, reorder by drag, delete. Synced across devices.

label: Layers · Lamplight
note: Answers is hidden (dimmed, eye-off). Background is locked. Diagram is at 70% opacity.

label: Arrange popover
note: Order, group, lock, align ×6, distribute ×2, flip. Shortcuts shown.

label: Chalkboard + grid
note: Ink flips to light on dark boards automatically.

label: Pages mode · A4
note: Pages stack vertically for handwritten notes and printing.

label: Chooser · Lamplight
note: Not sure? Start with Board. Templates and Import rows sit under the cards; the folder picker stays.

label: Note card states
note: Collapsed, card, expanded (inline editor), missing note. Plus Mermaid card, link card, PDF page card (Later).

label: Convert menu
note: Always a copy. Each target says what is kept and what is lost.

label: With presenter notes
note: Notes come from the frame description.

label: Same controls in every workspace + phone remote
Whiteboard · PDF, one page per frame
note: Scope Frames with thumbnails; 3 of 5 picked. PDF adds page size, orientation and margins.

label: Canvas · PNG transparent · too large
note: Background Transparent shows a checkerboard. At this size the browser limits scale to 3×, said in one line.

label: Architecture · Mermaid + copy menu
note: Extra formats: Lumen code, draw.io XML, SQL DDL, Markdown with a component table. Mermaid kinds: architecture-beta, flowchart, erDiagram, C4, block-beta.

label: Rendering
note: Rendering runs off the main thread; Download shows progress.

label: Media placeholders warning · Paper
note: GIF and video can’t animate inside images.

label: Phone · one sheet with sections
note: Preview on top; options scroll under it; Download stays pinned.

label: Canvas export
note: Canvas-only toggles: card style, group labels, edge labels.

label: Tool wheel
note: In pen mode one finger pans, so the wheel opens with a two-finger long-press.

label: Arabic · RTL
note: Dock, sheets and header mirror. Drawing, arrows and handwriting never mirror.

label: 50 / 50 · Lamplight
note: Typing updates the canvas within 300 ms; existing nodes keep their positions; only new nodes get placed.

label: Hover code ⇄ node
note: Hover line 9 and DB highlights; hover a node and its line lights.

label: Syntax error
note: Inline marker, wavy underline, one-line banner. Canvas keeps the last good diagram.

label: Autocomplete
note: Icons, node names and keywords.

label: Paste-in conversion · Paper
note: Paste Mermaid, draw.io XML or SQL DDL → inline confirm bar.

label: Properties · Lamplight
note: Name, kind, icon, technology, description, status, links (notes, RFC, REQ-n, repo, hub cards), owner, cost, SLA, tags, reuse.

label: Describe → diagram
note: Also code, OpenAPI, docker-compose, k8s, Terraform, SQL, an RFC note, or a whiteboard sketch.

label: Edit by instruction · diff
note: Added green, removed red, changed amber, on the canvas and in the code. Accept or Reject.

label: Review
note: Explanation, single points of failure, missing auth / encryption / backups, STRIDE. Turn into a note or tasks; Docs and Flashcards tabs.

label: Insert existing object
note: Linked objects show “Used in 3 diagrams”; edits update everywhere.

label: C4 component level
note: Double-click a container to go in; breadcrumb back.

label: Version diff
note: Compare two versions from History.
